$comment: Scene builder SB3 build rules (D341): how slots of a reference read (SB2) become layers of a NEW scene. Data, not code: the builder (services/scene-builder/build.mjs) reads every number from here. status unverified: the values are the agent's first proposal from the drawn fixtures and the existing presets, not checked on a real stream.
minConfidenceSource: SB2 rules give 0.55 to 1 on clean drawn slots (docs/evidence/2026-11-11-sb1-sb2-reference-read.md); below 0.5 a slot is a placeholder, never a guessed layer

sourceSize.source: assumed capture size when the device has no format (the same default as services/project/hud-zones.mjs)

game.source: AGENTS.md live-test rule: frame the V scene so nothing important is cut off; the game is never cropped, on both canvases

camera.source: cover the slot with a centre crop of at most 40 % of a side, else contain; registry/presets/scene-default-v.json crops the facecam 328 px a side of 1920 (34 %)

overlays.source: overlay folders the existing project's chat and alert layers use (legacy layer map; registry/presets/scene-default-h.json events layer)

panel.source: radius classes of the read mapped onto the brand radius tokens (--radius-none, -sm, -md, -pill); no token is larger than md except pill

v.safeSource: the V output goes to YouTube; the Shorts safe zone is the only V safe zone in the repo (unverified there too)

h.source: a left column for camera, alerts and chat with the game beside it, as in registry/presets/scene-default-h.json
